title: Worker and service-worker code loading bypassed the registry isolation gate

reproduction.beforeFix: External Worker and SharedWorker construction, service-worker registration, and importScripts calls returned pass, including statically aliased forms.
reproduction.afterFix: The source-isolation gate rejects worker constructors, service-worker registration, and remote importScripts URLs through direct and statically aliased references.

rootCause: Network isolation recognized request APIs but did not classify Worker/SharedWorker constructors or service-worker script-loading entry points as executable remote-code loads.
remediation: Resolve statically aliased worker constructors and service-worker/importScripts functions with the TypeScript AST, then reject active worker loading without evaluating contributor code.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "remote worker and service-worker code loading"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: direct and aliased worker-loading forms returned pass
validation.releaseAudit: 16/16 behavioral gates, production builds, bundle budgets, provenance/security audits, and dependency audit passed

runtimeBoundary: This is local static source-gate evidence. It does not replace deployed preview sandbox, CSP, or gateway verification.
